prerequisites.label: Skill 02 - Back Yourself Up Protocol
prerequisites.satisfy: The Back Yourself Up Protocol skill in this harness must be learned first (SKILL.md declares it mandatory). It is part of this install's harness skills; re-run the installer or install it on its own.

prerequisites.label: agent-browser (PRIMARY browser engine, browser-engine contract)
prerequisites.satisfy: The harness's agent-browser lane must be available, driven per Skill 71's browser-engine contract (the claude-nine mapping). SKILL.md declares it mandatory: 'agent-browser must be installed - PRIMARY browser engine'. Required for the PRIMARY lane. The documented degraded exception is an explicit Playwright-only mode with a MEMORY warning (lane 3 escape hatch) - it must be an explicit operator choice, never a silent fallback. Without the agent-browser lane every page build falls back to the Playwright engine, which SKILL.md documents as the fallback for known-hard flows only, and cross-origin iframe drag/drop stops.

prerequisites.label: GoHighLevel Firebase refresh token (TOKEN-ONLY auth)
prerequisites.satisfy: Add GOHIGHLEVEL_FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN=<token> to the install's secrets env file (the file $SECRETS_ENV designates; chmod 600), or export it in the environment. Aliases GHL_FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN and FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN resolve to the same credential. This is the ONLY auth path (SKILL.md D7 TOKEN-ONLY): the token alone seeds a logged-in session with no login form, no password, and no two-factor. CAF_FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN is not in the secret-name canon and does not satisfy this check.

prerequisites.label: GoHighLevel location id
prerequisites.satisfy: Add GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID=<location id> to the install's secrets env file (the file $SECRETS_ENV designates; chmod 600), or export it in the environment. Alias GHL_LOCATION_ID (and HIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID / LOCATION_ID) satisfies this check. Per SKILL.md the media pipeline's resolve_location_id() additionally falls back to the FIRST id in GOHIGHLEVEL_ALLOWED_LOCATION_IDS or CAF_ALLOWED_LOCATION_IDS when the scalar vars are empty - those two list vars are a fallback, not the primary declaration.

prerequisites.label: GoHighLevel LOCATION PIT (media-scoped API key)
prerequisites.satisfy: Add the LOCATION-scoped PIT as GOHIGHLEVEL_API_KEY=<pit> to the install's secrets env file (the file $SECRETS_ENV designates; chmod 600), or export it in the environment. Alias chain per SKILL.md: GOHIGHLEVEL_API_KEY -> GHL_API_KEY -> GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_PIT -> GHL_LOCATION_PIT (GHL_PIT / GHL_PRIVATE_INTEGRATION_TOKEN also resolve via the secret-name canon). HARD RULE: the AGENCY PIT (GOHIGHLEVEL_AGENCY_PIT / GOHIGHLEVEL_AGENCY_API_KEY / GOHIGHLEVEL_CONVERTANDFLOW_AGENCY_PIT / GHL_AGENCY_PIT) 401s for media upload - NEVER substitute it. This token is what media upload REQUIRES.

prerequisites.label: Browser capability probe run before first build

check.note: Advisory: no offline check can prove a browser lane works on this host. browser_manager bm_ensure proves the PRIMARY lane at build time.

prerequisites.satisfy: Run the capability probe (run_probe) before the first build: it classifies the host lanes (agent-browser, Playwright, CUA; the OpenClaw managed-browser lane reports structurally absent in this harness) and writes working/skill6-capability.json with selectedLane and the fallback chain. bash tools/browser_manager.sh ensure is the mandatory gateway that proves the selected lane. Re-run after any browser tooling upgrade.

prerequisites.label: OpenClaw managed browser (NOT available in this harness)

check.note: Not applicable here: the capability probe reports this lane structurally absent in the Claude Code harness; it is never selected and never required.

prerequisites.satisfy: No action: this lane does not exist in this harness. Skill 6 runs on the agent-browser lane (PRIMARY) with the Playwright fallback. (Source-side note: on the OpenClaw harness this was an optional upgrade lane for iframe-heavy builds.)
